assertions.title: The report builder offers the bookings and waitlist_entries subjects

network: GET http://localhost:3001/acme/reports/token -> 200 (kody; subjects include bookings and waitlist_entries)
evidence.consoleErrors: none in either session (agent-browser errors empty)

assertions.notes: Positive half: as kody on /acme/reports/new, the Subject dropdown lists 15 options including 'Bookings' and 'Waitlist entries' (round 1 listed 13 and neither). Both are selectable: Bookings switches the timeframe field to 'Starts at', Waitlist entries to 'Joined at'; a Bookings report grouped by Status ran against real acme data (Seated 45.7% (16), No-show 20.0% (7), Finished 17.1% (6), Booked 11.4% (4), Cancelled 2.9% (1), Confirmed 2.9% (1)). Cross-check GET /acme/reports/token -> 200 with top-level subjects and minted-token claims both = [phone_calls, orders, order_items, order_options, time_entries, shifts, bookings, waitlist_entries]. Saved-reports index (/acme/reports) renders; the report saved during this session, 'R2D Bookings subject check', is listed with subject label 'Bookings'. The saved-report route (/acme/reports/aena8zazml4v9sy40455meyc) renders and its Subject dropdown offers the same 15-option list including Bookings and Waitlist entries — all three fixed routes verified. Negative half: a fresh restricted operator (role 'R2D Reports no reservation': read_settings + read_phone_call only, no reservation grants) was created via Settings -> Roles -> Settings -> Members invite, signup completed in session cf9b643b8455__r2d-restricted. On /acme/reports/new the restricted operator's Subject dropdown has 10 options and neither Bookings nor Waitlist entries; GET /acme/reports/token -> 200 with subjects = ['phone_calls']; /acme/reports shows no Saved reports section and kody's saved Bookings report answers 404 at its direct URL. Tokens are described, not printed (redacted in the JSON evidence).

frictions.description: The open Subject listbox is not exposed as options in the accessibility snapshot (it renders in a portal overlay) and a `find text` click on 'Bookings' was refused as covered by a fixed overlay. frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser eval --stdin with DOM-dispatched PointerEvent/MouseEvent; verified the selection through the Subject button label.
